meta.interpretation: The user wants the annual trend in the number of pembrolizumab trials registered on ClinicalTrials.gov, counted by trial start year from 2015 onward.
assumptions: Trials are counted by their start year, not registration or completion date.
The user's term 'Pembrolizumab' is passed as-is to the intervention search, so the API's synonym expansion (e.g. Keytruda, MK-3475) is included.
All study types and phases are included, including observational studies; trials with no reported start date are excluded.
The final year shown may be partial, since recently started trials are still accruing in the registry.
meta.counting_semantics: Each trial is counted exactly once; bucket values partition the 2,891 analyzed trials.
